fusions.name: Girdled Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls you through everything near you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Between the Scales
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Thorned Hide
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Layer on Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
